# Sensor ranges, equations and sources

*Generated by `scripts/generate_samples.py` from `astrosense/backend.py`.*

## Equations

```
EQUATIONS USED
Min-Max scaling:   x' = (x - xmin) / (xmax - xmin)
Isolation Forest:  s(x) = 2^(-E[h(x)] / c(n)),  c(n) = 2H(n-1) - 2(n-1)/n   (Liu, Ting & Zhou, ICDM 2008)
Health score:      piecewise-linear map of s(x): 100 up to the 95th percentile of healthy scores, 80 at the flag threshold, 0 at s = 1
Deviation:         z = (x - mean_healthy) / std_healthy
Solar power:       P = P_peak * cos(theta) * sunlit
Battery:           dSoC/dt = (P_solar - P_load) / E_cap ;  V_bus = N_s * (3.5 + 0.7 * SoC)
Tank blow-down:    P * V_gas = const  ->  P = P0 / (1 + V_used / V_gas0)
Hydrazine flow:    mdot = F / (g0 * Isp)
Cabin gas balance: dp/dt = g - lambda * p   (material balance, Perry, ICES-2019-58)
Dalton's law:      p_i = x_i * P_total
Thermal lag:       T' = (T_eq - T) / tau   (first-order, C dT/dt = Q - (T - T_env)/R)
```

## Sensor ranges

| Sensor | Unit | Nominal range | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Battery / Bus Voltage | V | 24.5 to 29.4 | 28 V-class unregulated bus (NASA/TM-2003-212304; Bekhti 2022). Band derived: 7-series Li-ion pack, 3.5-4.2 V per cell. |
| Solar Array Output | W | 0 to 179 | Small-spacecraft panel peak power 2-179 W (NASA/TP-20250000142, State-of-the-Art Small Spacecraft Technology). 0 W in eclipse. |
| Propellant Tank Pressure | bar | 5.5 to 24 | Hydrazine blow-down 24 -> 5.5 bar, MEOP 24.6 bar (ArianeGroup PM25 monopropellant system datasheet). |
| Thruster Mass Flow (firing) | g/s | 0.13 to 0.47 | mdot = F/(g0*Isp): 1.0 N, 215 s @ 22 bar -> 0.47 g/s; 0.25 N, 200 s @ 5.5 bar -> 0.13 g/s (PM25 datasheet figures). |
| Engine Core Temp | C | 250 to 480 | ASSUMPTION - not sourced. Replace with your thruster datasheet limits. |
| Avionics Temp | C | 5 to 45 | ASSUMPTION - not sourced. Replace with the unit's qualification temperature limits. |
| Cabin Total Pressure | kPa | 97.9 to 102.7 | ISS cabin design range 97.9-102.7 kPa (NASA NTRS 20120015343); NASA-STD-3001 Vol. 2 [V2 6006]. |
| Cabin O2 Partial Pressure | kPa | 19.5 to 23.1 | ISS design ppO2 19.5-23.1 kPa (NASA NTRS 20120015343); NASA-STD-3001 [V2 6003]. |
| Cabin CO2 Partial Pressure | mmHg | 1 to 3 | NASA-STD-3001 Vol. 2 [V2 6004]: 1-h average <= 3 mmHg; ISS observed 1-9 mmHg (NASA OCHMO-TB-004; Law & Alexander, NTRS 20150019624). |
| Gyroscope Drift | deg/s | 0 to 0.05 | ASSUMPTION - not sourced. Replace with your gyro datasheet bias stability. |
| Reaction Wheel Speed | RPM | 500 to 5000 | Max speed 4500-5000 rpm for CubeSat-class wheels (CubeSpace CW40K, AAC RW400); +/-6000 rpm for large wheels (JAXA/MPC Type L-A). |
| Radiation Dose Rate | uSv/h | 8 to 25 | ISS effective dose ~0.2-0.5 mSv/day = 8-21 uSv/h (crew dose review, PMC10919966); South Atlantic Anomaly 50-60x higher (Pille, IAC-07). |

Rows marked **ASSUMPTION** have no source yet: replace them with your hardware datasheets.
